newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Sept chain store sales fall 8.9 pct mth/mth.
newsitem.headline: Japan Sept chain store sales fall 8.9 pct mth/mth.

text.p: Sales at chain stores in Japan in September fell 8.9 percent from the previous month to 1.27 trillion yen, the Japan Chain Stores Association said on Thursday.
Year on year, chain stores posted a 0.9 percent increase in September.
Sales of certain fresh food items continued to be sluggish due to lingering concerns about a nationwide epidemic of food poisoning this summer, the association said.
Meanwhile, sales of outdoor goods and other items for leisure activities were slow also due to the food poisoning and unusually cool weather in early September, the report said.
Chain store sales in the January to September period totaled 12.9 trillion yen, up 0.2 percent from the same period a year ago, the report said.
The report is based on a survey of 132 operators of chain stores in Japan.
